pages.title: Install, then activate
pages.text: Wear power armor or hold an Enhanced Energy Sabre or Energy Lance in your main hand. Press the configuration key, normally $(thing)0$(), and select a piece.$(br2)Click its module icon to install from your inventory or remove it. The checkbox enables the installed module; the last control assigns hotkey group $(thing)1–4$(). Use fuel arrows to add both dust types. Keep active usage within the piece’s limit: normally 100, or 130 with Energy enabled.

pages.title: Return or close
pages.text: Press the configuration key again from an equipment panel or the help page to return to the equipment selection menu.$(br2)Press it while the selection menu is open to close the panel.

pages.title: Respect each piece’s limit
pages.text: Each equipment piece has its own fuel and module budget. Active modules normally have to fit within $(thing)100$() usage. An enabled Energy module raises this to $(thing)130$() and improves fuel duration.$(br2)Too many active modules prevent that piece’s abilities from working. Disable an ability or add Energy before heading into danger.

pages.title: Set up quick toggles
pages.text: Assign modules to a hotkey group in the equipment panel. One group can toggle several modules across your worn armor and held weapon.$(br2)Groups 1 and 2 default to Numpad 7 and 8. Set the other groups in Controls.$(br2)Test fuel, activation and movement before a risky climb or fight.
